messages:
alisa: opening a short PR to add a split-tunnel verification section for Private installs (wireguard + ipsec). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/ABCD. need quick review on the cli checks and a tiny post-install sanity script.

greg: looks good. please include a one-liner conn-checker that tries both admin and data ports: `nc -zv -s 10.250.100.2 kms.example.com 7443 && nc -zv -s 10.250.100.2 kms.example.com 51820` and explain exit codes.

ryan: add `ip rule show` + `ip route show table wgroute` examples so customers can confirm split-route is active. Also suggest `tcpdump -n -i any udp port 51820` for wireguard visibility.

alisa: adding a tiny script `check-kms-tunnel.sh` that wraps those checks and prints clear remediation hints. will also mention to verify `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward` and firewall nat rules.

greg: small docs nit: link to existing nftables/iptables snippets instead of duplicating. fix one broken link in examples/nftables-wg.md — it currently 404s.

alisa: thx, will update links. tagging @eng-sre for a quick smoke test and adding "needs eng-sre validation" to PR checklist.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/ABCD (files: docs/private/split-tunnel-checks.md, scripts/check-kms-tunnel.sh)

ryan: one more quick idea: include expected `wg show` output snippet for successful handshake and a short troubleshooting row for MTU mismatch (suggest `ping -s` test and mtu tweak).

alisa: done. pushing final commit now, will request reviews. thanks!
